description: Return the machine-readable submission rules (required fields, KO rules, bundle rules). Call this before submit_new_software so a build passes review. Public, no API key required. Recommended workflow for a new submission: 1. get_submission_requirements (this tool) → 2. preview_marker (paid tools only, embed CRELA_SDK_MARKER before building) → 3. precheck_build (dry-run gate check, catches problems before wasting a review slot) → 4. submit_new_software (creates the listing and starts review; pass the storage_path from step 3 to skip a second upload) → 5. upload_screenshot (at least 3 images - the review agent scores presentation, and a listing without them loses buyers) → 6. check_review_status (poll every 30 s until review_job_status is not "queued"/"running") → 7. get_review_report (read full findings after completion). For subsequent releases of an existing tool: 1. get_sdk_marker (paid tools: fetch current marker for the existing software_id) → 2. precheck_build → 3. update_software → 4. check_review_status (poll until complete). Never use submit_new_software for a tool that already exists.
name: get_submission_requirements
title: Get Crela submission requirements
